name: Cold War [VIETNAM]
desc:
A large-scale 80 player shooter set in an alternative history scenario where the cold war goes hot, engage in a fun simcade combat experience, fight among destructible environments, use realistic loadouts with unique weapons and features within them.

All scenarios and events depicted are fictional and do not represent real historical events.

Exploiting permanent bans, these can be appealed in the communications server, do not lie.
Exploiter association is bannable.
